evidence: Nestled in the heart of a serene suburb, the Kim Truc Tu Pagoda, or Chùa Kim Trúc Tự, stands majestically, its elegant, sweeping roof system rising like a sacred ink wash painting, a testament to the harmonious blend of spirituality and the worldly. This tranquil structure, situated along the banks of the Red River, has been a beacon of peace and tranquility for centuries, its history dating back to the era of land reclamation and settlement.
